notes.content:

This update adds full Italian, German, and Czech localizations to the game. We are also continuing to fix small bugs and improve performance, plus we've updated the game engine version for a more stable experience.

notes.title: Brazilian Portuguese now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/606c27e2e7d2fee2f1aeffb20eb56f44598c9c1a.jpg[/img]
Ele voltou! Após um grande trabalho em ATOM RPG, Edson Junior retorna em ATOM RPG: Trudograd com mais uma tradução profissional PTBR, tornando os dois jogos da série acessíveis aos jogadores da língua portuguesa.
 
Foram mais de 800 mil palavras neste trabalho que, somadas às do primeiro ATOM, totalizam por volta de 2 milhões de palavras. Muito esforço, dedicação e estudo foram necessários para localizar a personalidade (ou personalidades!) de nossos personagens e vencer algumas limitações técnicas impostas pelo próprio jogo.
 
Nossa equipe agradece imensamente seu empenho e profissionalismo!

Se você é desenvolvedor e quer disponibilizar seu jogo no idioma PTBR, entre em contato com o Edson [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/nasher_adp]@mundonasher[/url]! [[url=https://www.instagram.com/mundonasher]Instagram[/url]] [[url=https://twitter.com/mundonasher]Twitter[/url]]

Esperamos que gostem da localização e, como sempre, agradecemos seu [[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1139940/discussions/0/3828665107788439536/]Feedback[/url]].

We are pleased to announce that Trudograd is now localized in Brazilian Portuguese. The translator, Edson [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/nasher_adp]@mundonasher[/url], who previously translated Atom-1, has done a great job. We sincerely hope you will show your appreciation for his excellent translation by liking it.

P.S.: We are always open to new localizations, but as you can see, it takes time. So, please write in the comments which new localization you would like to see for Trudograd.

Thank you for your attention.

notes.title: The final countdown: only 24 hrs left to support our new project!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/b01b19ff65c67443660d790c96f3ecbbe6807bbf.jpg[/img]

Greetings, friends! 

Today is the day! Our team's newest cRPG project—the Baldur's Gate 1 inspired Swordhaven: Iron Conspiracy—has only 24 hours left on the clock for its Kickstarter campaign. We are happy to say we are fully funded, and almost reached the final stretch goal: Festivals and Holidays. 

This is a group of events familiar to those of you who played Atom and Trudograd during festive seasons, and it will add festivals to the game world! On specific days, the different peoples of Nova Drakonia will celebrate various holidays—both historical and religious: 

Herbal Eve, with its traditions of leaping over bonfires and eating special cheese with caraway seeds; the ritualistic burning of the effigy of Alb the Færy, the evil warlock who long ago almost destroyed the first Empire; or Šeršet Day, when villagers dress as evil spirits and roam from house to house singing obscene songs and demanding treats.

And many more!

If you wish to help us reach this final stretch goal, please visit the campaign page here: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/atomrpg/swordhaven-iron-conspiracy?ref=2fcuyp]CLICK HERE!!![/url]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/atomrpg/swordhaven-iron-conspiracy?ref=2fcuyp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/2b3c4033dc2b9def09725f10df07dbf6e3a71db7.gif[/img][/url]

We are very thankful for your support during the campaign and hope you'll enjoy Swordhaven! Creating this game and the campaign around it is a huge learning experience that will surely help us when we create ATOM RPG 2. We are really blessed with the best players out there 🙂

Yours, Atom Team

We thank you for reading and hope you'll enjoy the update,

Atom Team

notes.title: Trudograd 1.0 RELEASED!
ATOM RPG: Trudograd Release Date Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/3e686c9fbc98c5bf004a0b94e3754b3a26645c92.jpg[/img]

Dear friends!

Finally the moment has come when we can announce the release date for [b]ATOM RPG: Trudograd[/b].

This event will happen on [b]September 13th, 2021[/b]. 

Until then we will use every minute available playtesting the game, fixing bugs, checking out different PC configurations and planning for upcoming content patches.

Spending more than a year in Early Access we have once again found that you, our players, are the greatest source of motivation and inspiration. Your support means the world to us. Your critiques, ideas, advice, the help you offered in bug fixing, planning new features and perfecting mechanics, are what Trudograd would never survive without.

It is thanks to you that Trudograd, initially planned as a small DLC, grew into a game with tens of hours of content, new features, and interesting new ways to play. Original voiced text quests, new skill tree, new locations and characters, perfected balance are just a few of the things you helped us reach. 

It is only natural that we wish to thank you for going above and beyond in helping us. That’s why everyone who owned Trudograd in Early Access will get a small free DLC gift called the [b]Veteran’s Pack[/b] which will include a new uniform, a Veteran’s medal and a pretty nifty little thermos that will help you in your travels.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/0b1508ff56ea5e8fe9e5e311c0e1a0f8e4283003.png[/img]
Thank you again for your support, trust and patience. And as always, let there be… ATOM!

See you on the release date!

notes.title: Patch 0.9.1
Update v.0.9
April Update ver. 0.8.1
Trudograd: Road to Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/c8f3433c86adbd05d8f7fe2f55859ea5db7938c7.jpg[/img]

[b]Greetings, friends![/b]

Since the last update, we have released a fair few patches and continued actively working on the new batch of content. Together with that, we’re trying to always be there to read your amazing feedback and cooperate on the features, fixes and changes you recommend. 

All in all, we have come a very long way since the start of the Early Access, and right now we’re giving it our all to improve the already made parts of the game, and add new ones as the plot demands it. 

Seeing how this is a very hard process that’s also very difficult to track, we decided to share our Roadmap with you, so that you always be able to see where we’re at in the development process.

This roadmap contains general information about the work we have already done, as well as about the features and content we’re planning for the release. It doesn’t include post-release support, because we’re never setting an expiration date on that part of development, as some of you already know.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/767eeecfca7270c9e9cc41accbaf88cd602814fd.jpg[/img]

[b]April[/b]

We’ll start off with a big content update. 

Afterwards, we’ll continue adding to the game, focusing more and more on the main plot line. New characters will appear in the [i]Outskirts[/i], [i]Grey Corner[/i], [i]Factory[/i], [i]Mikhalych’s Tavern[/i], [i]Police[/i], [i]Docks[/i], [i]Kolotushkin Str.[/i] Plus, we’re already adding the first people for the upper tier of the city. 

April will also be a month we rebalance some of the weapons and skills; we’ll also continue working on visuals and soundscape. 

[b]May-June[/b]

All of our team’s strength will be used to finalize the main story line and the mechanics that are already in the game. We’ll then work on some of the yet unintroduced mechanics you asked us for, and add to some special locations we’re not willing to spoil just yet :)

After the big update planned for this time period, you will finally be able to finish the game! 

The development process won’t stop there, however, since it’s not all about the main plot. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/3f52cc6a319abe7d131941d9ddcd3dc1e33b64bc.jpg[/img]

[b]July[/b]

After finishing the main storyline in all of its forms, we will expand the roster of side quests and plot unrelated locations. We’ll set to finalize the Lighthouse, the Caves, the new bunker and we’ll add to the locations that already exist.

[b]August[/b]

Random encounters and adventure maps will receive new additions in this part of the work process. We’ll also add a few special side quest lines and characters to the upper and lower tier locations. 

[b]September[/b]

This month will be used to stabilize and finalize the game before release. It’s the last month for finishing all major additions to the game, making the last icons, objects, sets of armor, loading screens, etc. We’ll also finalize the trade and combat balance. 

[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] Before the release hits, we’ll have to wipe the old save files, to ensure the correct compatibility between the new and old content, as well as optimize the game’s performance.

We wish to deeply apologize for postponing the release. Our communal wish to make Trudograd a really great game brought us before new quality standards, which unfortunately ask for more resources, finances, and most importantly - time. 

Although this was not an easy decision to make, we don’t want to cut the game Trudograd became and wish to tell its story to the fullest. We value your support and understanding over all else. Thank you for being with us. 

And let there be ATOM!

notes.title: V0.8: The Special Armor Update!
This year’s summary and plans for 2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/a04b4e3bbc1965bf1c83f7d14ccd0717804283d8.jpg[/img]

Greetings, dear friends!

Soon this year will end. And what a year it was. We had our share of grief, like most. Yet it was also quite productive for our games. Here, we would like to share with you a small summary of everything we managed to do, as well as give you a brief look into our team’s future goals. 

The main achievement of 2020 for us is undoubtedly the launch of ATOM RPG: Trudograd into Early Access. The game, which was planned as a small add-on to the original quickly grew due to your fair criticism, ideas and recommendations.

Due to your feedback, a lot of new mechanics were added to the game, such as area of effect attacks in melee, new throwing weapon features, special armor abilities. 
We made new animations, widened the initially planned locations, made new side quests, improved on the game’s graphics and soundscape. 

Of course these new features also extended Trudograd’s estimated time of arrival, since it is now a much more serious project than planned. But we are entirely sure the wait will be worth it. 

Apart from that, in 2020 we continued improving our first game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/552620]ATOM RPG[/url]. Listening to your wishes, we ported it to a wide variety of platforms like [url=https://apps.apple.com/app/atom-rpg/id1465288147]iOS[/url], [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.atomrpg]Android [/url]and [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/atom-rpg-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url]. 

We also continued our work on the original Steam version of the game, eradicating new bugs you helped us find, improving on compatibility with weaker computers, and most importantly adding new translations. It is thanks to volunteers from our community that the game has received French, Spanish, Chinese and Italian translations, with several more in the beta stage and even more to come!

Now we would like to share our plans for 2021. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/c474f1972e54f20318ef07bcab83105bc834e471.jpg[/img]

First of all, we would like to mention Trudograd. The development of this game is our number one priority and it won’t even stop for Winter holidays. In the upcoming months we will show off new interesting locations and will add new characters and quests to those areas that already exist.

In the major updates that will precede Trudograd’s launch, you will get to see new regions outside the city walls, with their own unique visuals, random encounters and enemies. 
You will visit Trudograd’s Hydro-Electric Plant which produces power for the city, as well as a desolate village not yet swallowed by the metropolis. 

You will also be able to venture up onto the second tier of Trudograd to see how the richer people live. You will even get to reach Seventh Heaven and see the authorities of the metropolis!
Our other plans include:

Porting [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/552620]ATOM RPG[/url] for XBOX and PlayStation consoles, just like some of you always wanted us to do. 
Making Bombagun, a mini-game some of you enjoyed in Trudograd into a standalone free app for iOS and Android. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/5865430308304c6c437143d4131ef5d245c31d5c.jpg[/img]

Launching the full version of Trudograd and actively supporting it.

There is another big project planned for 2021, but it’s too early to share any details about it. As soon as design documents and first batches of concept art are ready, however, we will show and tell of everything we have conceived in this regard, and we really hope that you are going to like it! :)

In the end of this summary, we would like to wish you all a happy New Year. We really hope that you will all stay safe and healthy, as well get to have amazing holidays! 

We are truly thankful for everything you did this year. Without your helpful reviews, ideas, suggestions and the way you spread information about our games, we would have achieved nothing! 

Thank you for staying with us… And let there be ATOM!

notes.title: New Update and Live Stream Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, friends!

Today we wanted to make several announcements.

Firstly, we are very happy that the reception of last week's update was so positive.
But thanks to some of your more critical feedback we also see what we can do better moving forward. So keep on sending us your ideas. This is the fuel that keeps us going!

We will try to implement some of the smaller suggestions in the next patch, but the bigger ones will have to wait for the next huge update.
By the way, we already started working on it and are ready to shed a little bit of light on the new content that will be available in it.

You will be able to visit the upper (or rather rooftop) city, a place that is different from the lower slums not only in living standards, but also quests and encounters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/09d5a0718b40c4861a8a09d60afde1f1d5ceeaef.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/75117c519a556e01a390e6e57f90dd1f5c365e26.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/ece6f17693d772883898a8f3137a05a31f4955b2.jpg[/img]

Also, special armour and weapons will get new enchantments. As well as a new quest for those who bought the finest armor in all of Trudograd.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/e5d77ebaae58a797b4f21e88e616aedc9f4b72d4.jpg[/img]

Moreover, we want to add a couple of improvements to the UI. For example: write the name of the active object if you press ALT, add some features to the global map, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/ebbe7a7c737993c15decf90aa4f0e392fefefcb9.jpg[/img]

It will be very interesting to hear your opinion when we will present you with those new features.

[b]***[/b]

At the moment, Atom RPG: Trudograd has been in Early Access for six months, but during this time it has outgrow our initial plan for a small story expansion. Now it’s shaping out to be a real game with many new characters and quests, made with a new level of quality.

Of course, this transformation required significantly more time than we originally planned for, but we hope that it will pay off in the most important thing - creating the kind of game that you expect from us!

We plan to release the full game in the beginning of 2021. Hopefully not even reaching a year in Early Access :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/7fbadb95cebc20833ccc823eefe6904d6c7adf74.jpg[/img]

Also, for those of you who are interested we want to announce that we will be having a live Q&A on YouTube!

We rarely have time for something like that, but we wanted to finally interact with you, guys. English stream will be held on December 12, Saturday; at 16:00 Eastern Time Zone.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TqTSZknpMn8&feature=youtu.be][b]~STREAM~[/b][/url]

Take care and let there be Atom!

notes.title: Update 0.7: Special Armor Edition
Next big update announcement
notes.content:
Hey, guys!

Work on the next big update for the Early Access is going as planned, that’s why we decided it’s high time we announce some of our work to prepare you for what awaits in the future ;) 

First off, new plot related missions are being prepared to take you to new locations and make you meet exciting new characters. New random encounters are also being added to the city map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/6bc68e166825e642ee7352aa77c6426dfc19c916.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/fd4a777b84cd36c3cd8dc8f76aa70a39ed60b738.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/091237587dd9d50fce9a524ad1ca35136df46256.jpg[/img]

Old locations are getting new life. The last bit is especially true for the city docks area. There will be also plenty of new sidequests for those who want to take a break from the plot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/6dcd899716cf9daf70f70323158cfe843fdebb15.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/44af91f3364799af5d0efb550885959ebb51b5ab.jpg[/img]

The characters will be revamped to new graphics standards with much more distinct facial features, and we’re not talking about portraits. The new facial detalization system is almost implemented into the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/f1b651b9a22485bd87797333162edf67b218568e.png[/img]

This new feature along with new animations will surely set the bar higher for Trudograd graphics-wise. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/b8ddf08307a054aafbe2cfcb50834f0d9bd146c2.jpg[/img]

We really hope that these new visuals will be to your liking, and we’d love to hear your critiques on this matter. 

The combat system was perfected with new features and tweaks to balance, inspired by you, our amazing community. Combat is still a work in progress, though, so some of it might change in an update or two. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/bbe338538a5e53b80cdf70a51a02bf966411ca00.jpg[/img]

And of course, this update will be the first one ever to feature the… On the other hand, let’s not ruin the surprise ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/b85bca1407b0e2f08bb2b79bb39d69a7145aa0be.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/d1e7a9553d56eea4a5c0e927695b2ff4fd0e91d5.jpg[/img]
[i]WIP[/i]

Stay tuned, friends. We’re thankful as ever for your unending support.

Have a spooky Samhain! 

And as always… Let there be ATOM!

notes.title: 0.6.72 Bug fixes
Newest content update
News About The Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/135e435d8f55b058b2076b2185b37a8ce07680a0.jpg[/img]
Greetings, friends!

Today we would like to share some information about the upcoming update for ATOM RPG: Trudograd, which will be published in the near future!

In the upcoming update, you will get to visit new locations -including the city port and a giant ship in the open sea- with their unique characters, quests and merchants, as well as find new additions to locations you already visited in the current version of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/0b9cf047833a5c4b46c50dd3ae92c0223ad4ed07.jpg[/img]

The plot will be expanded with lots of new adventures, in which you will be offered a role of an action movie hero, get to meet an entirely new faction of characters, and get sent into a den of vile cultists!

Also, you will now be able to join the city police. Unless you completed all three of the revolutionary missions, you will be able to ditch your comrades and join the force (works the other way around as well).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/a847011e35e3398b15120de6b6151b32d087375a.jpg[/img]

The two-handed weapons will be finally available in the upcoming update! This unique weapon type not only has its own rules for ignoring armour and dealing critical damage, but also comes with it’s own mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/0d3caad3fbf44f47c05d252701228f49fda32b0c.jpg[/img]

After carefully examining the feedback from our players we also made some adjustments to the abilities. We fixed problems with the armour and evasion bonuses, improved the mechanics that give you or your enemy's critical conditions and many, many more.

Naturally, the update will also feature new improvements, bug-fixes, animations, vignette quests, and many more goodies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/e10b88197eedd8cc8e5260b5e3aed81322700f13.jpg[/img]

The date of the update will be announced soon. Meanwhile, please check out these screenshots of new things to come!

Thank you for being with us on this journey. And let there be ATOM!

ATOM RPG Trudograd is about a third of a game but a great third
notes.content:
The heavily Fallout-inspired ATOM RPG has been on my “play more” list for almost a year, since I enjoyed a few hours of it but was distracted by something else. It is my fault. I am very distractable. Happily its developers, AtomTeam, have just released a standalone expansion called Trudograd. It entered Steam Early Access on Monday (or you can get it on GOG, if you prefer).If you’ve not played ATOM, Trudograd is a surprisingly welcoming place to start, but my advice is to give it a while longer in the oven. I have a feeling it’ll be worth the wait.

The setup of ATOM, and in fact an awful lot of what it does, will be familiar to anyone who’s played the original Fallout games. America and the USSR nuked each other, and the remnant of a semi-legitimate military/scientific organisation sends you out into the wasteland many years later to explore. You’ll wander a dusty geigerworld fighting mutants and grumpy men in makeshift armour, visiting settlements and talking to many people, discovering a sinister plot along the way. Character levelling works similarly, with a high emphasis on core attributes like strength and intelligence, which are directly tested in dialogue, and skills like medicine, lockpicking, and crafting having a drastic effect on what your options are when it comes to resolving fights and subplots.

notes.title: ATOM RPG: Trudograd in Early Access
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/35ff4b7380a3fcf1a1b25c0473a4f1f1e557481a.jpg[/img]
Dear friends!

Today, after a half year of work, we are glad to present you with Atom RPG: Trudograd, our newest game published for Early Access!

Trudograd is a story in which your adventures in the Central Wastes continue after two years. In it, you will venture into a city that survived the war, to uncover its secrets in a search for a piece of pre-war technology that might just change the world forever.

You will be able to play the game by creating a new character which will be level 15 from the start of the game, to represent that you’re no longer playing as a cadet, but as a major of ATOM. Or, you can transfer a save file made after beating ATOM RPG’s final boss and continue playing as your old ATOM RPG character. The choice is yours!

We are publishing to Early Access to learn all of your wishes, critiques, ideas and general feedback on the early stages of development with a goal to implement the best ones, making Trudograd a community effort created by players for players. It worked amazingly well last time, and we hope to repeat that success.

From the get go, Early Access is going to feature updated graphics, updated roleplaying system (WIP), several large locations, dozens of quests, a hundred unique characters, new mini game, new quest format for some quests and many more interesting additions.

This version of the game will be updated every few months, with the final release sometime later this year.

We really hope you’ll like it! Thank you for your support, and...

Welcome to Trudograd.

notes.title: Trudograd releases into Early Access on the 11th of May
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37498939/ef8d137d28df3e965db20da6ebbcebdbef98e0a2.png[/img]
Greetings and salutations, friends!

Today we are finally ready to name the release date of our next game. Atom RPG: Trudograd is coming out into Early Access on [b]May 11th 2020[/b].

Previously, Early Access became the most important tool in our arsenal. Because of your feedback, advice and general ideas, Atom RPG became a game many enjoyed. From bug fixing, to new details, weapons, quests and even visual solutions like the isometric camera mode, we owe it all to you, the players.

We hope that you will contribute your feedback this time around as well. Only our cooperation with you can make Trudograd a truly great experience.

Though there is a lot of work ahead of us, this time the first Early Access version will be much more developed than the last. It will feature five large locations, 100+ characters, several dozens of quests, including the starting ones of the central plot line, new weapons, new items, new abilities and a new type of visual quests.
We will also add updates every few months, so there will be more for you to explore.

We really hope that you will enjoy what we prepared for you. See you on May 11th!

We hope you are all doing well. Take care of yourselves. And, of course… let there be ATOM! :)

Yours, Atom Team
